_doc: Channel release-schedule state machine. Read by the daily-shorts-pipeline routine at fire-time to decide which verticals + formats to produce. Updated manually (or by phase_N_report.md output) at phase transitions.
_kept_verticals_note: Phase 1 rotation pool. Cases excluded to conserve EL budget (already have 6 live in old format). Story vertical added 2026-05-18 — AI-generated narrative shorts (3 sub-genres rotating: numbered survival, Reddit dramatizations, horror micro-fiction). Phase 2 narrows to top 2-3 by median avg view %.
_priority_note: Story vertical claims BOTH slots in every fire (exclusive mode) until story has 12 cumulative QUEUED+RENDERED+DELIVERED entries. After that, balanced rotation across all 7 verticals resumes. Bootstrap math: 12 stories in ~6 fires ≈ 1.5 days, then other verticals come back online.
_story_subgenre_note: Within the story vertical, rotates through 3 sub-genres for production variation. Sub-genre encoded in queue filename: SY_NN_S_* (survival), SY_NN_R_* (Reddit), SY_NN_H_* (horror).
_story_budget_note: Soft cap at $130/mo for Replicate (Flux + Pika). Actual projected spend at 1-2 stories/day ≈ $42-63/mo, well under cap.
_videos_per_fire_note: Cap is 2. Phase 1+2 produce 2 different verticals per fire. Phase 3 may produce 2 of same vertical with different hook formulas.
_fires_per_day_note: Bumped from 3 to 4 on 2026-05-18 (Creator EL tier unlocked headroom). Fires at peak Shorts windows: 7:07 AM commute, 12:07 PM lunch, 6:07 PM after-work, 9:07 PM prime-time evening. Total: 8 videos/day, 56/week, ~9 per vertical in Phase 1.
_el_budget_note: Soft cap at 90k chars/mo (10k headroom under Creator's 100k). Upgraded from Starter (25k cap) on 2026-05-18 after user moved to Creator tier. Hard refuse at 90k unless --over-budget flag passed.
_auto_advance_note: Always false. Human approves each phase transition after reviewing phase_N_report.md.
